title: hujjat se ye dunya qayam hai
body:
Hujjat se yeh duniya qayam hai Qayam se zamana qayam hai
Dil hijr me jal kar khaak hua par dil ki tamanna Qayam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis pardah nashee'n ne duniya me qud pardah uthaya hai apna
Kotaahi dast-e-shouq he tak mashooq ka pardah qayam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ankho'n me wahi hai dil me wahi raste me wahi mehfil me wahi
Qilwat me wahi mehfil me wahi phir parde ka parda qayam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghaflat se musalmano chownko kuch ghour karo soncho samjho
Dunya se shah-e-laulaak gaye kiske liye duniya qayam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Quran nahi itrat se juda farmaa gaye Mahboob-e-Khuda
jo toote na roze mahshar tak woh dono me rishta qayam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum pardah utha doge jis din duniya ka bharam khul jayega
Haq yeh hai tumhaare pardeh se ek ek ka pardah qayam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Inkar jinhen hai ghaibat se ae Qais woh imaa'n kho baithe
Hum ghaib pa imaa'n rakhte hein imaan hamara Qayam hai
